title: British troops massacre civilians at Jallianwala Bagh
summary: Troops under General Reginald Dyer fired without warning on a crowd gathered in the Jallianwala Bagh garden in Amritsar, killing hundreds of unarmed people.
reason: British authorities feared unrest after protests against the Rowlatt Act and had banned public gatherings.
significance: The massacre turned many Indians against British rule and strengthened the independence movement.
